description: Fork of exp052 v2 (joint BitMultiHeadLUT Q/K). Restructured Q/K: tph=128 (vs 1024), input_nap=8 (vs 5, → 256 entries/table), output_nap=256 (vs 32). Same votes/pair=33 and same total LProjection cost, but 8× fewer tables / 64× richer per-table capacity. Tests sparse-coverage regime: per-head input pair coverage drops to 22.5% (vs 112%), each table is much more capable. Bit budget for Q/K grows 8× (6.29M → 50.3M). V and out_proj unchanged from exp052 v2.
